fields: as a table: cols [your request, first response, what follows], rows [request, first response, what follows], intro, nav. Cells may be {t, link, intent}.
best_for: RiserValves sets a table of response times by request on a navy sheet with one riser pipe: a valve per request tees into its first response, and a second branch runs under it and turns up into what follows, so the eye goes from request to response to follow-up.
